description: CYCLIST+IMU synchronises images from a vehicle-mounted camera with inertial measurements from sensors on a bicycle and the observing vehicle. The research team supplies cyclist yaw and roll angles, semantic-segmentation polygons, regions of interest and image-derived relative-depth maps. The public OSF registration API confirms the named archive and explains that the updated release blurs faces before distribution. Registry metadata assigns CC BY 4.0, making reuse free. The collection covers selected urban acquisition sessions, not a continuous city traffic census, and its top-level metadata does not establish a complete calendar span. Estimated depth should be distinguished from independently measured depth. The data can test cyclist perception and sensor-fusion components in transport simulations. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: CYCLIST+IMU
notes: G4-0224; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
